I replied to Dana in her #north-team thread: the 2026 renewal at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 261 seats.

- **Where the figure comes from:** Ilse posted 261 in #north-team on Oct 14. Dana is in that channel, so she could already see it.
- **What I couldn't confirm:** the public files show the renewal was signed on 2026-03-20, but none of them give the seat count. I found no signed renewal document Dana can see, so Ilse's post is the only source for 261.
- **Older number:** the last count Dana posted in the channel was 185 seats under Amendment No. 1 (August 2025). I pointed out that 261 replaces it.

I suggested she check with Ilse or June if the tracker needs the signed number. A seat count is an account detail, not a money figure, so no approval was needed. I didn't take any other action.
